lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Telluride Town Council's Monday session, where the 2027 budget and property tax levy go to a vote alongside second reading of an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year — a real tension between tight finances and the land-conservation commitments this valley has long held dear. Ouray City Council is doing the same kind of heavy lifting on its own 2027 budget, mill levy, and fee schedule, while Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission digs into foundational Land Use Code and Master Plan updates that will shape what gets built there for years. And if you're waiting on workforce housing on Black Bear Road, the Telluride Housing Authority draws master lease lotteries for two properties Monday night.

notable.stake: Norwood's Land Use Code and Master Plan updates shape future development patterns.
